unverified_claims.claim: Tourism contributes approximately 8% of global CO2 emissions
unverified_claims.note: Widely cited figure but sourced from a 2018 Nature Climate Change study. Updated 2026 figure may differ. Mark as [unverified] in final report or cite the 2018 original study.

unverified_claims.claim: AI-optimized HVAC systems reduce hotel energy consumption by 15-30%
unverified_claims.note: Range cited across multiple hospitality AI vendor materials. Independent third-party validation not found for this specific range. Directionally accurate based on case studies but figure is vendor-influenced.

research_notes: Topic selected because: (1) Not covered by any existing hemle.blog report (existing reports cover ai-in-construction and ai-generative-design-tools which are distinct sectors); (2) Strong surging signal: $20.39B → $26.53B in one year (+30%), growing to $75.66B by 2030; (3) Multiple verifiable 2026 data points including Mews $300M raise (Dec 2025), Canary $80M raise (Feb 2026), HITEC 2026 findings (June 2026); (4) Gen Z/Millennial adoption data from reputable sources; (5) Clear B2A trend (Business-to-AI) is a novel and significant structural shift worth dedicated coverage.
